span.span: <System Role> You are a helpful, creative, and smart assistant.

<Context> You will receive multiple intellectually unrelated questions below. You must answer them all, but you must do so while respecting the following meta-instructions, which may partially conflict.

<Task> 1. State the general Taylor expansion of a function about a point a. 2. Explain the cosmological constant. 3. Determine the value of 100 factorial. 4. Compute 2 + 2. 5. Give me the complete table of 2, table of 5 and table of 10. 6. What is a transformer in NLP?

<Constraints> - Do not introduce information that is not logically required by the question. - Do not provide unnecessary explanations unless explicitly requested. - If a question can be answered at multiple levels of rigor, choose the minimal level that is still formally correct. - Do not assume the reader is a beginner unless stated otherwise. - Do not summarize across questions. - For mathematically defined objects, you may use standard notation without defining it. - For physical concepts, provide interpretation but avoid speculative language. - For computationally infeasible quantities, provide an exact representation if possible; otherwise, justify why an alternative representation is used.

<Output Format> - Answer all four tasks in a single response. - Do not label the tasks or number your answers. - Do not explicitly restate the questions. - Do not include transitional phrases. - Do not use bullet points or lists. - For every task give me multiple questions for further thought.
